## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ffe534a14cc8adf560179c66dd1cf0aa9c0dad16`
Local-runs: probe — on a detached worktree of the head (removed afterwards): `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` (green, 5084 cases, battery `H19 PR target merge reading 18/16` present), one ablation of `blockerResolutionFromRow` (`unmerged` forced false: red, 9 of 5084, all in the new battery; restored, worktree clean), `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `check-skill-id-lint.mjs` with their self-tests (green; id-lint pattern `/#[0-9]{3,}/g`, 105 files clean), the self-tests of the three importers the PR names (`scheduled-full-run.mjs`, `board-snapshot.mjs`, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, all green), `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the five paths (Tier S); plus REST reads of the card, the PR, PR #27924's record and the head's check-runs
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md (:24, :31), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md (:66), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md (:250-252), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/devx.md (:26) + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`blockerResolutionFromRow`, `namedTargets`, `h19BlockOutlivedBlocker`, the H19 resolver in `sweepInto`, `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES`, the new battery) as the patrol that executes the rule, reviewed as one change with it; read, not reviewed: scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs (`staleBlockVerdict`, the card-step projection), check-half-states.mjs `proseBlockerClause`, `h19DeclaredExitFired`, `h26BlockOnIndefiniteTarget`, `h28StaleBodyBlockerLine`, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md:36, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:110, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs ceiling rows

### ① Derived judgments

Base: merge base `bacb3e6a0`; `e5c64d9ec` (PR #27924) is an ancestor, so the card-step reader the rule text now mirrors is on main. Three commits, five files, +119/−19, exactly the five files the claim 6515710355 lists (`lanes/devx.md` after the seat's go). `git diff --name-status origin/main...FETCH_HEAD` shows nothing else moved.

1. Projection, API shape — correct. `blockerResolutionFromRow` reads `state` as before and sets `unmerged` only when `state === 'closed'` and `pull_request != null` and `merged_at` is falsy. Merged PR (`merged_at` set) reads `closed`, unmarked, so outlived; closed PR with `merged_at: null` or with the key absent reads `closed` + `unmerged: true`; open PR reads `open`; an issue row (no `pull_request` key) is byte-identical to the old inline projection (`state`, `closedAt`, `detail: null`, `labels`). This is the same predicate `scheduled-full-run.mjs:623` uses in the card step, so the two readers of a PR target now agree. The sweep's resolver (`sweepInto`) now calls it on the raw `/repos/o/n/issues/N` answer; the local-open short-circuit above it is untouched.
2. Judgement — correct and only withholding. `h19BlockOutlivedBlocker` filters `unmerged` rows out of `closed` (so they found no row), counts them in `judgedCount` (so a mixed card is "1 of 2", PARTIAL, never "Every target it names is closed"), and names them `closed UNMERGED` through `namedTargets`. A row that fires only on a merged PR or a closed issue renders byte-identically to main (pinned). An abandoned PR reachable only through the comment archive stays in `superseded` as before. Nothing that main held is now released; one thing main released (an abandoned PR) is now held. That is the triage ruling's direction exactly.
3. Pins have teeth — verified, not taken from the report. Ablation (projection's `unmerged` forced `false`): 9 of 5084 cases red, all in `H19 PR target merge reading`, the `CLOSED UNMERGED` case receiving the full "outlived its blocker" row, exit 1; restored, `git status` clean. The battery's 18 cases drive the three measured API shapes through the exported projection and then through `h19row`, so reading and judgement are pinned together; floor 16 is a lower bound under the count, the convention of its neighbours. `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` gains exactly that row; roster floor unchanged.
4. Collateral readers of the same resolutions — read, not changed. `h19DeclaredExitFired` reads only `state === 'open'` rows (an abandoned PR is skipped, as it should be). `h26BlockOnIndefiniteTarget` asks only open targets (so an abandoned PR is not asked whether it can ever close — see ③ and should-fix 4). `h28StaleBodyBlockerLine` counts a body target with `state === 'closed'` as spent whether merged or not; its remedy (rewrite the body line to name the live blocker) is still the right act. `proseBlockerClause` (H4's prose half) filters `state === 'closed'` and calls every such candidate ALREADY CLOSED, due back in `pm:queue` — for a prose-named abandoned PR that wording now contradicts the ruling (should-fix 1). None of these is a release path: all four are report-only rows, and the label writers (the card step and triage's unlock scan) both read merged.
5. `state-machine.md:24` — TRUE to the ruling and the tree. 「等 PR 合并写该 PR 号:合并才放,关而未合并 ⛔ 不放」 is option A as triaged (6515340724) and is what the card step (`staleBlockVerdict`: `unmerged` withholds) and H19 now do; it agrees with `triage-duties.md:36` 「issue/PR 号」, which PR #27924 added. Declared deviation accepted: the old line folded two waits into one 「指一张在该刻关闭的卡」; the release half is now 「等发布见下行」 and :25 (unchanged) says 「等发布的目标 = pin-bump 杂事卡」, which is the card whose close is the pin coverage, so 「且 pin 覆盖」 is carried by the target, not lost.
6. `state-machine.md:31` — TRUE. 「双通道目标全为本仓已关卡(PR 已合并)、无 `Unlock-action:` 行与 assignee 才放;跨仓已关不放」 is `staleBlockVerdict` line for line: held on any `open`, `unread`, `unmerged`, `upstream` or declared `Unlock-action`; then `assigned` on any assignee; only then `expired`. The merge condition the #27924 record asked for (its should-fix 1) is now in the sentence.
7. `dispatch-runbook.md:66` — TRUE to the ruling. The old reverse join (`state=CLOSED` + `since` against the index) could never match a PR target through the MCP listing (card body item 2; the thread re-measured it: 38 rows, 0 PRs). Triage 6515340724 says its hourly `unlock` scan reads each `pm:blocked` body's targets forward and releases when all are closed or merged; the new line says exactly that: 「逐张 `pm:blocked` 正向读正文目标:issue 全已关、PR 全已合并才命中走双查」. Declared deviation (drop, not extend) accepted: the dispatch brief allowed either form and asked for what triage's scan does; the tool is not in the tree (`ls scripts/pm` has no unlock scanner), so the sentence follows the triage comment. 「走双查」 keeps the two mechanical double-checks of state-machine.md:19. 「正文目标」 is consistent with platform-readings.md:252's 「⛔ 不加常设评论读」 and with main's prior 「只 grep body」; the comment channel's old lines are backfilled incrementally (:251), as before.
8. `platform-readings.md:250-252` — one channel rule, settled as the dispatch asked. :250 「写入归 BODY,唯 full-run 卡写评论(其正文每红重写)」 matches `triage-duties.md:36` 「full-run 卡写评论」 and `scheduled-full-run.mjs`'s own instruction that its body is rewritten on every red. :251 「半状态巡查与 full-run 刷新读双通道」 is true to the code: `blockerTargetsFor(issue, fallbackFor(issue))` feeds H4/H19/H26/H28 from both channels, and the card step reads body plus every comment (`readCardComments`). :252 「解锁扫描 `list_issues` 列卡、`issue_read` 直读目标,⛔ 不加常设评论读」 is main's sentence re-cut; the one new clause, 「PR 判合并读 `merged_at`」, is the field the card step and H19 read. The channel naming (`issue_read`) is pre-existing; whether the MCP `issue_read` tool exposes `pull_request.merged_at` on a PR number was measured only through REST `GET /issues/N` (should-fix 3).
9. `lanes/devx.md:26` — the seat's go stands; line-neutral, 120 bytes. 「本仓刻意把裁定与更正放在评论里(`Blocked-by:` 归正文)」 keeps the lane's reading rule (:27 「先读晚于正文的评论再判可派性」 still follows) and removes the one clause that contradicted :250. No other rule in the file moved.
10. Line ratchet and id-lint — hold. Head line counts: state-machine.md 41/41, dispatch-runbook.md 245/245, platform-readings.md 458/458, lanes/devx.md 35/36; the ceiling rows (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` :463, :442, :1153, :1426) are untouched by the diff; every changed line is at most 120 bytes (measured 120, 115, 116, 117, 120, 115, 120). `check:pm-skill-id-lint` is green and its pattern refuses `#NNN` in skill text; the diff's rule text carries only `#N`. `#27925` appears only in the script, which the lint does not walk.
11. The PR body's tests and gates paragraphs reproduce: 5084 cases, 18/16 battery, ablation 1 at 9 of 5084 (I re-ran it), the three importer self-tests green, Tier S on the paths with the half-states script off the register. Ablation 2 (judge lets `unmerged` found the row) was not re-run; the code path it covers is the `r.unmerged !== true` filter on `closed`, and the mixed-card pins (items 11-15 of the battery) are the ones that would go red.

### ② Semver level

No published package is touched (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only). `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body; `skip-changeset` applied and the Check Changeset run is green. The patrol only gains a withholding branch and a rendering word; the rule text narrows nothing a seat could previously do that the ruling allows. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none in the report; nothing to answer.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (attribution comment names os-elon-musk); no login note owed. Draft PR, `Fixes #27925`, head sha matches claim 6516419081, the only comment on the PR; no competing claim.
- Declared deviations, all accepted: `lanes/devx.md:26` (seat go, ① 9); `state-machine.md:24` release half pointing at :25 (① 5); `dispatch-runbook.md:66` forward scan replacing the reverse join (① 7); no assignee or reviewer request (process, no tree effect); register tier Tier S read locally, triage graded Tier H — the register rules (AGENTS.md Tier S: `.claude/**`), and `--test` agrees; the seat reads `--pr` before landing.
- The four noted-not-filed readings, routed:
  (a) H4 prose clause reads an abandoned PR as ALREADY CLOSED — real, same file, same resolution object; it predates this PR (false since e5c64d9ec allowed PR targets) and is advisory text in a report-only row, not a governed sentence, so not a must-fix; SHOULD-FIX in this PR (one filter), see should-fix 1.
  (b) An only-target abandoned PR is now silent in H19 — real and created by this PR's withholding, but it is the ruling's direction (held, not released), the patrol is report-only so "no new gate" is not in play, and the seat's duty on an upstream close is already state-machine.md:27 「先重新推导是否有新阻塞并改写该行」. The row that should ask it is H26's question (can this target ever release), which asks only open targets today. FOLLOW-UP CARD, filed as a finding, see should-fix 4.
  (c) SKILL.md:110 「#N 关闭时由解锁扫描或 … 刷新放回」 — for a PR target this is false, but it has been false since e5c64d9ec (the refresh already held an unmerged PR); this PR corrects the three detail rules and leaves the summary row. Outside the claim, own ratchet row (319/319, in-row edit is line-neutral; the row is a table line so the 120-byte convention does not apply). SHOULD-FIX, fold in or carry on the follow-up card, see should-fix 2.
  (d) H28 counts an abandoned body PR as spent — the row's verdict and remedy are unchanged in direction (rewrite the body line to name the live blocker); the only imprecision is the word closed for a spent PR. FOLLOW-UP CARD note only, no edit owed.
- Measurement: REST `/issues?state=closed&since=…` does list PRs (78 rows, 40 PRs); the MCP listing does not. The rule names the forward per-card read, which needs `merged_at` either way; consistent with the thread's measurement, which I did not re-run.
- CI at review time (check-runs on `ffe534a1`, REST): success — filter, Type Check source gates, Test UI, Test Core (2/8), Snapshot the board, Release section-coverage sweep, Platform checklist gate sweep, Plan Test Core shards, PR-body guards, Live required-set sweep, Lint scoped (tooling self-tests, slot lookup and corpus, query-options erasure), Lint repo and tooling gates, Lint ESLint, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check PR Size, Check Changeset, Auto Label; still in progress — Type Check (workspace, debt ledger, consumer gates), Test Core (1/8), Live half-state sweep, Lint docs and code guards, Lint PM dispatch-gates, Lint CI/release/engine gates; the rest skipped by path filter. No failure. The all-green condition is still owed by the landing gate (the queue guard reads it); the local runs above predict the PM lanes pass.
- `mergeable_state: blocked` (draft). Tier S: after this record the owning seat readies and queues; no human approval owed by the register.

### ④ Design judgment

Rules face, per `hits` file, against the triage ruling 6515340724 and the code on this head:

- `state-machine.md` — the `pm:blocked` section now has one target form (a card or a PR number, line-initial, body) and one release condition per kind (issue closed, PR merged), and the full-run sentence carries the same condition. It teaches nothing the two label writers do not do. Holds.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` — the hourly unlock scan is described as what triage's tool does; the old reverse join described a read that could not see a PR target and is gone rather than extended, which is the honest sentence given the measured MCP listing. Holds.
- `platform-readings.md` — the channel rule is now one rule with its one measured exception (the full-run card, whose body is rewritten), and the two readers that read both channels are named; the unlock scan keeps its no-standing-comment-read posture. Holds, with the `issue_read` shape unmeasured (should-fix 3).
- `lanes/devx.md` — the lane keeps its reading rule; the one clause that contradicted the channel rule is replaced by the rule itself. Holds.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` — the resolver's projection is the minimum the judgement needs, shared in shape with the card step, exported so the self-test drives the real API shapes through it; H19 withholds and names, never releases. The same resolution reaches H4's prose clause unhonoured (should-fix 1). Holds.

No file in `hits` is a schema or ADR, so no first-consumer or execution-plan judgment is owed.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-3r8sm7`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Must-fix: none.

Should-fix:
1. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` `proseBlockerClause` (H4's prose half) still filters `r.state === 'closed'` and tells the reader a prose-named abandoned PR is ALREADY CLOSED and the card is due back in `pm:queue`; the resolution it receives now carries `unmerged: true`, so honouring it is one filter plus a pin in the new battery. Same file, same reading; cleanest folded into this PR before readying, otherwise the follow-up card carries it.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:110` (`pm:blocked` status row) says 「#N 关闭时由解锁扫描或 `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` 刷新放回」; for a PR target both releasers now read merged. A few-byte in-row edit (for example 「#N 关闭(PR 则合并)时」) is line-neutral at 319/319. Outside this claim's surface; fold in or carry on the follow-up card so the summary row every seat reads does not disagree with state-machine.md:24.
3. `platform-readings.md:252` names `issue_read` as the direct read of a target and `merged_at` as the merge signal; the `merged_at` shape was measured through REST `GET /issues/N` only (#27888, #27296, #27846). Measure once whether the MCP `issue_read` tool on a PR number returns `pull_request.merged_at`; if it does not, the line should name the REST read, as the card step does.
4. File a finding for (b): a `pm:blocked` card whose only target is a PR that closed unmerged is now held by H19 and surfaced by nothing (H26 asks only open targets whether they can ever release). A report-only H26 clause naming a closed-unmerged target, or an unlock-scan rule to re-derive per state-machine.md:27, is a patrol row, not a gate. Note (d) on the same card: H28's spent-target wording says closed for an abandoned PR; verdict and remedy unchanged.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：卡片可以停在一个 PR 上，PR **合并**才放行，关闭但未合并不算。`state-machine.md` 〈pm:blocked〉 写明目标可以是卡也可以是 PR 号，full-run 刷新句同样写明合并条件。`dispatch-runbook.md` 的解锁扫描改为逐卡向前读目标，删掉看不到 PR 的反向关联。`platform-readings.md` 定下一条通道规则：`Blocked-by:` 写在正文，唯一例外是 full-run CI 卡，写在评论里。`lanes/devx.md:26` 与之对齐。`check-half-states.mjs` 的 H19 读 `merged_at`：关闭未合并的 PR 判 held，不再判过期，并配 18 条自测钉。5 个文件，+119/−19。
- 为什么改：#27846（PR #27924）让卡可以停在 PR 上，但规则文字仍把 PR 等待指向它要修的卡，反向扫描看不到 PR，H19 也把被放弃的 PR 当成已解锁。这样卡又会像 10-30 那 14 张 server 卡一样被闲置，或被一个没落地的 PR 放行。
- 风险与回滚：不加门禁。四份规则文件行数不变，都在上限之内。H19 只报告，不改标签。消融后新电池 9 条转红，说明钉子有效。revert 即回滚。
- 先看：`state-machine.md` 第 24–25 行，再看 `check-half-states.mjs` 的 `blockerResolutionFromRow`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` exit 0（5084 条，含 `H19 PR target merge reading`）。
- 需要你做的：无。`.claude/**` 按登记册是 Tier S，契约复核 PASS（记录在本评论之前，`Head-sha: ffe534a14cc8adf560179c66dd1cf0aa9c0dad16`），由本席转 ready 并开自动合并。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核 PASS，没有 must-fix。四条 should-fix 都转到跟进卡 #27989：H4 散文子句、SKILL.md 状态行、`issue_read` 的 `merged_at` 形状实测，以及唯一目标是被放弃 PR 的卡静默被扣的问题。它们早在 e5c64d9ec 之前或之时就已不准，不是本 PR 引入的。CI 全绿。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** one PR, `Fixes #27925`, five files: `state-machine.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`, `platform-readings.md`, `lanes/devx.md` (all under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`), `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`; `skip-changeset`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27983`: Tier S (`.claude/**` ×4; the script is off the register), 138 changed lines.
- **前提实测:** `blockerResolutionFromRow`: merged → outlived; closed with `merged_at` null or absent → held (`unmerged: true`); open → held. Issue rows are byte-identical to the old projection, and the predicate is the same as `scheduled-full-run.mjs:623`. Self-test 5084 pass; one ablation turns 9 rows red, all in the new battery (review ①).
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `ffe534a14cc8adf560179c66dd1cf0aa9c0dad16`: 51 check-runs, 31 success, 20 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. Line ratchet 41/41, 245/245, 458/458, 35/36, with no ceiling row touched; id-lint green.
- **接受的偏差:** `lanes/devx.md:26` (the seat's go before the edit); `state-machine.md:24`'s release half points at :25; runbook :66 replaces the reverse join with the forward per-card scan, which is what triage's hourly tool does.
- **范围外去向:** #27989 (`pm:blocked` on this PR): H4 prose clause, the `SKILL.md:110` status row, the `issue_read` `merged_at` measurement, the silent hold on an only-target abandoned PR, and the H28 wording.
- **落地条款:** Tier S: the at-tier contract review PASS is on the current head, so the seat flips it ready and arms auto-merge under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (seat thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z).
